game_concept: A action defense set in Mt. Pyre – Fire Shrine, an ancient fire shrine: the ash ranger must handle cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Compound Combo: Chain +=, -=, *= updates to hit a target value exactly.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Fire Shrine: an ancient fire shrine
core_gameplay_loop: In Fire Shrine, repeat each round: Chain +=, -=, *= updates to hit a target value exactly. Each round, cinder bats strike the obsidian gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the energy value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the obsidian gate from cinder bats in Fire Shrine: keep the energy meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 48-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: energy drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 48-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 7 (applied tier): Compound Combo
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how energy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cinder bats in Fire Shrine.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 48 seconds while energy > 0.
